summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Kosmo Tracking Sync Module - All 15 backend tests passed (100%), all frontend features verified working correctly

issues: React warning: indicatorClassName prop not recognized on DOM element - minor console warning, doesn't affect functionality (pre-existing from iteration 4)

post_sync_tracking_endpoint.details: POST /api/sync/tracking returns 200 with correct JSON structure: total_checked, updated, no_change, errors, details array

get_sync_status_endpoint.details: GET /api/sync/status returns 200 with last_sync timestamp, total_checked, updated, errors

dashboard_kosmo_sync_bar.details: Dashboard shows Kosmo sync bar with Radio icon, last sync time ('ahora'), stats (0 verificados, 0 actualizados), and 'Sincronizar ahora' button

sync_button_triggers_sync.details: Clicking 'Sincronizar ahora' triggers POST /api/sync/tracking and shows toast: 'Sincronización completada: 0 verificados, 0 actualizados'

journey_packages_section.details: JourneyDetail shows 'Paquetes (46)' section with 'Ver todos'/'Ocultar' toggle button

package_table_kosmo_indicators.details: Package table shows: tracking_url as clickable blue link, status badge (Entregado/Fallido), delivery time (05:49 p.m.), camera icon with proof count (📷 5), driver note tooltip (💬), sync clock icon (🕐)

kosmo_evidence_panel.details: Evidence panel shows at bottom of packages list for delivered packages with: tracking number, driver note in quotes, delivery time, photo count, external link to Kosmo

status_mapping.details: Kosmo 'delivered' maps to 'delivered' status, Kosmo 'cancelled' maps to 'failed' status

auth_required.details: Both endpoints require authentication (403 without token), accessible by both developer and agent roles

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing journey with Kosmo data (778b38e3-4e68-4b85-ad74-24ae02fef468) containing 191 packages with proof photos and 171 with driver notes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Kosmo Tracking Sync Module fully tested and working. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_kosmo_sync.py cover: POST /api/sync/tracking, GET /api/sync/status, package Kosmo fields (tracking_url, kosmo_status_raw, kosmo_proof_count, kosmo_driver_note, kosmo_scraped_at), status mapping (delivered->delivered, cancelled->failed). Frontend verified: Dashboard sync bar with 'Sincronizar ahora' button, toast notifications, JourneyDetail packages table with Kosmo indicators (camera icon, driver note tooltip, delivery time, sync clock), Evidence panel for delivered packages. Auto-scheduler runs every 30 min in background. Sync limits to 50 packages per call with asyncio.Semaphore(5) concurrency.
